ticket: Is my engraved order refundable 20 days after delivery?

documents.text: Engraved order policy: eligibility class = CustomCare.
CustomCare refund eligibility: window = 14 days after delivery.
General refund FAQ: Standard orders have a 30-day window.
CustomCare refund eligibility: window = 90 days after delivery.

synthesis.reply: No: engraved orders use CustomCare, whose refund window is 14 days after delivery. Twenty days exceeds that window.

abstention.reply: I could not find a supporting policy in your documents.
